map.为什么三相功率有 √3？: Why is there a √3 in three-phase power?
map.由三相相量关系导出，线电压是相电压的 √3 倍，总功率为三相之和，化简即得 √3: It follows from the three-phase phasor relation: the line voltage is √3 times the phase voltage and total power is the sum of the three phases, which simplifies to √3·U_L·I_L·cosφ.
map.零线什么情况会带电？: When does the neutral carry current?
map.三相不平衡或单相负载集中时中线有电流；断零更会导致相电压漂移烧设备，须可靠接地与: The neutral carries current when the three phases are unbalanced or single-phase loads are concentrated. An open neutral even causes phase voltage drift and equipment damage, so earthing and balance are essential.
